{{Top|leg}}
'''Yades''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew with [[Grace Command]]'s [[Devil Squadron]], a volunteer force led by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Lemayne]] which fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. While Grace Command was officially a mercy organization which fought the Sith warlords and distributed food supplies to civilians, its real mission was to disseminate the narcotic [[Deluge]] in Sith-occupied worlds. Yades and his fellow Devils attacked one of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crimelord [[Zodoh]]'s [[Stormdriver]] ships during the [[Battle of Capital Cay]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. Following the liberation of [[Capital Cay]], Yades rotated with the crew of the transport ship ''[[Mother Grace]]'' in order to allow the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] to borrow his [[Fire Lotus-class starfighter|''Fire Lotus''-class starfighter]]. Yades' decision saved his life since his entire squadron with the exception of their [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jenn Devaad]] were killed by Zodoh.
